# openwrt_firewall_ipset (Resource)

A named set (`config ipset`).

Manages a `ipset` section in `/etc/config/firewall`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Set name. (UCI option `name`.)
- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Comment. (UCI option `comment`.)
- `counters` (Boolean) Enable counters. (UCI option `counters`.)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the set. (UCI option `enabled`.)
- `entry` (List of String) Set entries. (UCI option `entry`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `family` (String) Address family. (UCI option `family`.) One of: `ipv4`, `ipv6`.
- `loadfile` (String) File with entries. (UCI option `loadfile`.)
- `match` (List of String) Match fields, e.g. `src_ip`, `dest_port`. (UCI option `match`.)
- `maxelem` (Number) Maximum number of elements. (UCI option `maxelem`.)
- `timeout` (Number) Entry timeout. (UCI option `timeout`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
